text: Ticket S V one one three two five, on staging, in Tech View. The work order number is now a blue link.
Clicking it opens the work order.
Progress is a thin bar with the percentage beside it, and the advisor's avatar sits before the name.
At Compact, the bar and the avatar get smaller, with no hours line.
Clocked In reads the same as in the List.
And the List keeps its own cells. The check passes.
